comment: env3 lab: SSH aliases of the two laptops (one role each), the repo path on them, and LAN addresses the agents must NOT reach (checked by the env3 lockdown probe). See docs/plans/2026-11-18-env3-implementation.md.

audio.comment: Desktop sound levels are a trial condition: run-half resets them before every trial (agents can change them with pactl) and records what it found.

obs.comment: Room recorder (OBS on the old Mac). env3.run starts a recording a few seconds before the agents start and stops it after both halves end; the file path goes into trial.json. Password is read from the recorder's OBS config over SSH at connect time.
